evidence.quote: by Jessica Baolin Nathen Harvey March 10, 2026 Posted in: AI Adoption Culture Productivity
To better understand the practical impact of AI on the SDLC, researchers conducted a thematic deep dive into 1,110 open-ended survey responses from Google software engineers in Q3 2025.
Google uses speed, ease, and quality (SEQ) as indicators of developer productivity.

Value Stream Management (VSM) can be used to evaluate current processes and to identify system bottlenecks signaled by downstream indicators like code review turnaround times, failed deployment recovery time, deployment rework rates, and production incidents.
Velocity gains for an individual author frequently translate into a significantly increased cognitive load for the reviewer.

evidence.quote: higher AI adoption is associated with an increase in both software delivery throughput and software delivery instability.

evidence.quote: While measures like lines of code accepted may still be a worthwhile indicator of tool adoption and effectiveness, AI can easily inflate the volume of code generated
